caption: The drawing depicts a patterned composition consisting of alternating squares in red and blue, forming a grid. Each square contains a different motif rendered in white against the colored background. The motifs include pairs of birds perched with their tails fanned out, symmetrical floral arrangements in vases, a pair of birds facing each other, city buildings, and detailed architectural houses. The left and lower borders of the drawing feature a series of smaller repeated architectural motifs in alternating red and blue. Along the left edge and bottom border, there is also a depiction of multi-colored fringe-like lines, primarily in red and blue, extending parallel to the edges, creating a woven or textile effect. The overall palette is dominated by strong blue and red hues with white details and some use of brownish-red in the patterns. The drawing uses a regular, almost checkerboard arrangement of blocks for the central design, with a patterned fringe outlining two sides.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
